title: Servo Drive Thermal Warning — Overtemperature
description: Servo drive temperature P017 = {val} °C exceeds 80°C. Drive will fault at 90°C. Current draw: X={val2}A, Y={val3}A, Z={val4}A.
probable_cause: Inadequate cabinet ventilation, blocked drive heatsink, or sustained high-load machining.
diagnostic_steps: Check cabinet fans are operational P071
remedy: Restore cabinet ventilation. Clean filters. If recurring, upsize drive cooling.
required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.
escalation_path: If AXS-MJ-002 is not addressed (stop current operation. machine must be inspected before resuming production.), the fault will escalate in this order: THM-MD-001, then AXS-CR-002, then ELC-MJ-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
